evidence.quote: The first was the evacuation of all the Republic’s citizens to the eighty-fifth administrative Sector. The second was Presidential Order #6609.

payload.description: Colorata opposition to the law was silenced; racial propaganda spread and Colorata were banished to internment camps and forced labor.

evidence.quote: Thus, all Colorata in the Republic were banished to internment camps where they were forced into labor

payload.description: Two years later, the Republic introduced the Juggernaut, piloted by Eighty-Six designated as Processors.

evidence.quote: The Eighty-Six who served as pilots were designated information-processing units— Processors—making the Juggernaut an Operated Drone.

payload.description: The Legion retreats; Lena’s third squadron loses seven Juggernauts and all seven Processors.

evidence.quote: her third squadron lost seven units. A bitter taste filled her mouth. Seven Juggernauts detonated, exploding along with the Processors who piloted them. None survived.

payload.description: Lena reports the enemy retreat and offers condolences for the seven lost; Pleiades’s Processor replies with cold contempt.

evidence.quote: Hope you enjoyed watching us pigs squabble through your little telescope, Handler One.

payload.description: The next morning’s news reports no casualties and announces the seventeenth ward will be abolished and its forces discharged.

evidence.quote: the seventeenth ward of the southern front will be abolished, and all forces stationed there dissolved and discharged

payload.description: At breakfast, Lena’s mother urges her to quit the army and find a groom and calls the Eighty-Six filthy animals; Lena defends them as Republic citizens.

evidence.quote: They’re respectable citizens of the Republic, same as you and me.

payload.description: Lena remembers a quadruped spider with a headless skeletal knight crest and a hand that saved her, colored brilliant red and jet-black.

evidence.quote: that silhouette of a quadruped spider, the crest of a headless skeletal knight etched upon its armor, the extended hand that had saved her from disaster

payload.description: Lena’s mother insists the Eighty-Six are barbarians to be confined; Lena finishes breakfast and leaves.

evidence.quote: You simply cannot get those barbarian Eighty-Six to understand human ideals and nobility.

evidence.quote: It’s the eastern front’s first ward’s first defensive squadron, also known as the Spearhead squadron.

evidence.quote: I’ll do it. I’ll put all my efforts into serving as the Spearhead squadron’s commanding officer.

evidence.quote: There’s no basis for confining the Colorata anymore.

payload.description: Annette offers Lena chiffon cake; she says her arranged-marriage candidate tested it and that she left a chocolate message for Theobald at his mistress’s apartment.

evidence.quote: Left it in the mailbox of the apartment he’s renting with his mistress.

evidence.quote: I hear Kujo got blown to bits.

evidence.quote: My paperwork’s increased. I guess I’ll have to start faking my patrol reports every day now.

evidence.quote: Focusing on something makes it so I don’t hear it as loudly.

payload.description: Handler One calls after dinner; she complains about Shin’s fake reports, demands handwritten reports, and asks about life after discharge.

evidence.quote: You sending me the wrong ones wasn’t a mistake.
Please send me reports on all your patrols so far, okay?
